request: 另外工作区可能会运行在ssh环境中，这时同样可用应该，同时支持用户密码，私钥文件等多种方式，私钥支持引用区域选择
acceptance: SSH workspace shell uses existing authenticated host connection, never installation-directory fallback
Device SSH supports password, private key with passphrase and default authentication; key selection from enabled workspace/reference trees
Secrets stay out of browser storage, logs, session metadata and tool arguments; real SSH regression covers authentication and cwd
scope: Terminal-only daemon context and source selector
Terminal runtime, PTY helper and workbench

requirements.summary: User asks SSH workspace parity and password/key/reference selection

design.summary: Terminal-only scoped context, existing SSH master pinned by inode, bounded reference-key transfer via private IPC to Linux memfd.

implementation.summary: Remote workspace shell and isolated local records; default/password/key auth; reference picker; compatibility flag.

verification.summary: Focused runtime, race and browser component checks PASS; full running-host UI NOT_RUN due existing start.command activation blockers. Formal Aide image release not attempted.

documentation.summary: README, protocol and changelog describe storage, authentication, compatibility and no secret copies.

cleanup.summary: Reviewed diffs, immutable prior releases retained, only own failed test processes stopped, unrelated tasks preserved.

release.summary: Terminal 1.2.0 prerelease and main source push; no formal Aide image release.

release_authorization: User requested 删除新标签页重新push release登记 and then added SSH workspace/password/key/reference requirements during the same active work.
rollback: Restore prior immutable plugin ZIP and corresponding host commit. Upgrade ends live connections; workspace logs and records stay on disk. No existing services replaced.
handoff: Use matching Aide main source build. Linux only; SSH device sessions originate from Aide runtime, workspace Shell uses remote workspace host. No production services restarted.
